ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every UBO, legal representative, and authorized attorney-in-fact against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, the Colombian UIAF preventive lists of terrorists and money launderers, and domestic adverse-media or PEP databases. Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons, high-risk jurisdictions, or unknown origin of funds. A documented negative match is required before filing the incorporation documents. If any positive match is detected, the matter must be escalated to UIAF as a suspicious transaction report (ROS), and the incorporation process must not proceed until the risk is cleared. Records are private and kept for at least ten years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) through the competent Cámara de Comercio, using the online name availability and reservation module (www.rues.org.co / respective Cámara de Comercio portal).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish or in a Latin-alphabet transliteration that is phonetically and grammatically acceptable in Spanish. Accents and Spanish diacritical marks are preserved in the registered name. An S.A.S. corporate name must incorporate the legal type suffix 'S.A.S.' after the chosen name. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing company, commercial establishment, trademark, or registered trade name in the RUES index. Foreign institutional suffixes such as LLC, Inc., or GmbH are not permitted in the registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Cámara de Comercio rejects the requested name, the applicant may file a recurso de reposición before the same Cámara within ten working days after notification, pursuant to Articles 74 and 75 of Law 1437 de 2011. The appeal must state legal and factual grounds, enclose evidence of distinctiveness, and may attach ministerial authorizations if the rejection was due to a sensitive token. In the event of a second unfavorable decision, the applicant may file a recurso de apelación to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within ten working days. The original 30-day reservation window is not extended by an appeal; the applicant should simultaneously reserve an alternative name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole registered office for an ISIC 7120 / NAICS 541380 dangerous goods testing laboratory. A physical laboratory space in Colombia is required to maintain accreditation traceability, equipment calibration, and safety protocols. A virtual office may be used only as an ancillary administrative correspondence address, but the company registry, ONAC accreditation assessors, and local fire-safety authorities require a verifiable physical domicile and lab site.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High – 75% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 to 18 months after licensing by ONAC, local fire prevention authority, municipal licensing authority, or Cámara de Comercio administrative verification, due to the hazardous UN38.3 lithium-battery drop-testing scope.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 1-11, 17, and applicable sections of Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971) on commercial registration
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (or municipal Chamber of Commerce) - Registro Único Empresarial (RUE)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation document) registered in the RUE; optionally protocolized as Escritura Pública before a Notaría
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for S.A.S. under Law 1258/2008; symbolic capital (e.g., COP 1) is permitted. Contributions may be cash, in-kind, or technology; up to 100% may be deferred for a maximum of two years. No escrow account is mandatory; paid-in capital is evidenced by a bank deposit certificate or asset-delivery act.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: In accordance with Article 17 of Law 1258 of 2008, the incorporators of [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. unanimously adopt this first organizational resolution: FIRST: SHARE SUBSCRIPTION. The authorized share capital is subscribed in full as stated in the bylaws; shares are assigned to each shareholder. SECOND: REGISTERED OFFICE. The registered office is fixed at [CITY], [DEPARTMENT], Colombia; the legal representative is empowered to execute the lease or acquisition documents. THIRD: OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. [NAME] is appointed General Manager and legal representative, and [NAME] is appointed Secretary, both accepting their positions. FOURTH: AUTHORIZATION. The General Manager is authorized to execute all registrations before the Chamber of Commerce, DIAN, and financial institutions. Adopted in [CITY] on [DATE].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Homonym Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (or municipal Chamber of Commerce) - RUES web portal (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a homonym search (consulta de homónimos) on the RUES portal to verify that the proposed company name is unique and compliant with naming rules; reserve the name for 30 business days and download the pre-approval certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If homonyms are identified, re-apply with the next alternative name; the reservation is automated on the RUES portal and corrected instantly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Authentication of the Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría (optional notarization) or private execution by all incorporators
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución and bylaws under Law 1258/2008, including corporate purpose, share classes, capital payment terms, and officer powers; all incorporators must sign. If banks or landlords require higher formalities, protocolize the document as a public deed (Escritura Pública).
required_dossiers: Shareholder identification documents and personal RUTs
Description of commercial activity under ISIC 7120
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary objects to any clause, amend the document and re-execute; legalize signatures before the notary to cure authentication challenges.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Chamber of Commerce (RUE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio - Registro Único Empresarial (RUE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed incorporation instrument and supporting attachments through the Chamber's online transactional service or in person; pay the registration fee and registration tax; the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal and obtains a provisional NIT from DIAN.
required_dossiers: Use-of-soil certificate or lease agreement of the registered venue
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the Chamber's correction notice within 10 business days by filing amended clauses or missing documents; if registration is denied, appeal to the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Electronic Billing Activation with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - www.dian.gov.co
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) and obtain the definitive NIT; assign tax responsibilities (corporate income tax, VAT, ICA, withholding at source); obtain the electronic signature (firma electrónica) and activate electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) within 30 days of registration.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation
Legal representative identity document and e-mail
Certified premises lease or ownership title
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify RUT information via the DIAN transactional portal; file tax re-consideration requests within 10 business days under Articles 720-726 of the Colombian Fiscal Statute.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Capital Contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank or corporate digital account provider (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking account using the Certificate of Existence and NIT; deposit the subscribed capital; obtain the deposit certificate (certificado de depósito) evidencing paid-in capital required by the Chamber and future lenders.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation
Identity documents of signatories and economic activity confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires beneficial-owner declarations, submit the ownership chart under Law 1258/2008; file a complaint with the Financial Ombudsman if the account is wrongly refused.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Corporate Books and Municipal Licensing Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (official books) and Alcaldía Local (zoning and fire safety)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the official corporate books (shareholder register, minutes book, and attendance book) at the Chamber within one month of incorporation; obtain the zoning certificate (Certificado de Uso de Suelo) and the fire department inspection certificate (Certificado de Bomberos) for the laboratory premises.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement of the laboratory premises
Building plans or technical load report for drop-test equipment
Fire extinguisher and safety equipment inventory
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If books are rejected, correct labels and pagination and re-present; if zoning is negative, request a temporary special-use authorization or relocate the laboratory before renewal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Organismo Nacional de Acreditación de Colombia (ONAC) - national accreditation body for ISO/IEC 17025 testing laboratories
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Acreditación de Laboratorio de Ensayo ISO/IEC 17025 for UN38.3 battery safety drop testing and CE-RED electromagnetic compliance testing, issued by ONAC

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and local Corporación Autónoma Regional (e.g., CAR Cundinamarca)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría III - Low-impact technical test laboratory; full EIA not required. Requires prior minor environmental permits (permisos ambientales menores) for wastewater discharge, air emissions, and hazardous waste generation under Law 99/1993 and Decree 1076/2015.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 ≤ 50 mg/L, TSS ≤ 100 mg/L (Resolution 0631/2015); air emissions: PM10 ≤ 50 µg/m3 annual average (Resolution 2254/2017); VOC control per Resolution 909/2008; hazardous waste: labelling, packaging, and storage limits for spent lithium cells per Decree 1076/2015 (Title 6) and battery take-back obligations per Resolution 1362/2007.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (Certificado del Cuerpo de Bomberos), structural load inspection for drop-test and thermal chambers, workplace occupational health and safety (SG-SST) program administered through the ARL, dangerous-goods storage authorization for lithium cells under Decree 1609/2002 for road transport compatibility, and land-use compatibility certificate from the local mayor.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – official portal www.dian.gov.co; online services operated through the MUISCA platform (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicios y Trámites).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident entity appointing a Colombian attorney-in-fact (apoderado) obtains a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) from DIAN and completes registration in the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) through MUISCA. For a Colombian S.A.S., incorporation before the Chamber of Commerce automatically generates a provisional NIT; the legal representative must complete the RUT, select tax responsibilities (IVA, withholding, electronic invoicing), and activate the digital signature before commencing taxable activities. Non-residents without a physical presence must use the empowered representative regime and may be required to post digital authentication credentials through DIAN's authorized service channels.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation – a Colombian S.A.S. is a separate taxpayer subject to corporate income tax (CIT); shareholders are not automatically attributed corporate taxable income and do not acquire a permanent establishment solely through shareholding.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not provide a check-the-box partnership election; the S.A.S. is taxed as a corporation by default. Available elective mechanisms: (i) optional accession to the Régimen Simple de Tributación for eligible entities with gross revenues below the statutory UVT threshold, integrating income tax and certain indirect taxes; (ii) tax consolidation election for parent-subsidiary groups satisfying a 100% direct or indirect control requirement; (iii) foreign tax credit planning and CFC/hybrid mismatch rules applying Brazil-style tax classification rules rather than entity elections; no hybrid entity election is available under Colombian law for domestic S.A.S. entities.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (IVA – Impuesto al Valor Agregado), a destination-based consumption tax administered by DIAN.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP – no general registration threshold for resident taxable persons: a Colombian S.A.S. must enroll in the RUT and register as an IVA responsible before commencing taxable operations. For non-resident foreign suppliers of digital services or goods to Colombian individuals, a special registration obligation triggers at annual turnover exceeding 41,000 UVT (approx. COP 2,333 million in 2024/2025 bracket, subject to annual UVT recalculation).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta – FEV) is required for all Colombian businesses. DIAN mandates real-time online validation via authorized billing software providers (proveedores tecnológicos) and the MUISCA system. The invoice must include the DIAN-assigned authorization number, CUNE (Consecutivo Único de Numeración Electrónica), CUFE/CUDS unique code, QR code, and be delivered to the specialized invoicing platform within DIAN-established deadlines. Export operations are documented through electronic export invoices (Factura Electrónica de Exportación) cross-matching the customs export declaration.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% IVA rate applies to: (i) tangible goods physically exported from Colombia under a valid customs export regime, and (ii) eligible export services performed in Colombia for the exclusive benefit of a foreign recipient, provided the service is declared as an export service under Article 481(b) E.T. and the regulatory conditions of Law 2010/2019 are met. Battery safety testing services (e.g., UN38.3 drop testing, CE-RED electromagnetic conformity) qualify when the test contract is signed with a non-resident party, the technical evidence is destined solely for use abroad, and the invoicing and foreign-currency repatriation requirements are satisfied. Zero-rating preserves the exporter's right to credit and, where applicable, refund of input IVA attributable to the export activity.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación – DEX) validated by DIAN or the port authority
Electronic Export Invoice (Factura Electrónica de Exportación) with CUFE/CUNE
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / Carrier's Truck Manifest confirming physical departure from Colombian customs territory
International Trade Commercial Invoice and, if applicable, Packing List
Certificate of Foreign Exchange Reimbursement or Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro / justificación de pago desde el exterior)
Certificate of Origin or other preferential documentation, when a trade agreement is invoked
Customs Exit Certificate / shipping manifest / scanner inspection record evidencing actual exportation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN performs cross-referencing audits using the customs electronic system (INS-SIGMA), the MUISCA electronic invoice system, foreign-exchange declarations, and bank remittance records to verify the reality of export transactions and the effective receipt of foreign currency. False, simulated, or abusive claims of zero-rating expose the taxpayer to: (i) immediate adjustment of the IVA assessed plus daily moratory interest; (ii) the statutory sanction for inaccurate returns under Article 648 E.T. (typically 100% of the omitted tax or claimed benefit); (iii) criminal prosecution for tax evasion under Articles 434A–434C C.P.O. where forged or misleading export documentation was used; and (iv) retrospective clawback for the relevant tax periods within the general five-year statute of limitations, extended to longer periods in cases of fraud or unreported offshore assets, including loss of the exporter status and exclusion from authorized economic operator programs.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) through the Foreign Exchange Statute (Ley 9 del 1991, Decreto 1068 de 2015) and the External Resolutions of the Junta Directiva del Banco de la República. The Ministry of Finance, Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, and DIAN administer enforcement. All cross-border operations must be conducted through the Mercado Cambiario and registered with Authorized Foreign Exchange Intermediaries (IMC).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains current-account convertibility of the Colombian peso (COP) for payments, transfers, profit repatriation, and trade settlement. Capital-account operations, including non-resident foreign direct investment (FDI) into a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.), are freely permitted but subject to compulsory declaration and registration with Banco de la República through an IMC. Profit remittances are permissible after the FDI is formally registered and tax obligations are settled. Dividends and capital reductions can be remitted abroad with an FX declaration and proof of prior FDI registration, without additional Banco de la República authorization, provided no unlawful capital flight indicators exist.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds from goods and services, including battery testing and laboratory services supplied to foreign clients, must be channeled through the Colombian foreign exchange market within six (6) months from the date of shipment for goods and generally within six (6) months from the date of accrual for services, as prescribed by Banco de la República's external regulations. There is no mandatory percentage surrender/conversion to the Central Bank; however, the foreign currency must be sold to a local IMC, deposited into a Colombian foreign-currency account, or otherwise channeled through the IMC within the applicable deadline. Failure to channel in time triggers DIAN penalties, loss of corporate tax deductions for unrepatriated export revenue, and could jeopardize future import/export privileges.

Operational Checking Account / Capital Escrow Account
Operational Checking Account / Savings for Capital Escrow

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low for primary treasury rail; Medium for ancillary outbound disbursements. Wise (TransferWise Ltd.) can execute low-value cross-border transfers in USD, EUR, and COP, but it is not a Colombian bank or an authorized FX intermediary (IMC). A Colombian S.A.S. cannot satisfy central bank FX channeling, export-proceeds repatriation, FDI registration, tax payment, or corporate banking KYC solely with Wise. A local bank account with an IMC remains mandatory for peso clearing, FX declarations, capital integration, and regulatory compliance. Fintech EMIs may therefore be used only as a secondary rail for small trading counterparty settlements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Colombian banks, as a policy and under the Superintendencia Financiera's risk-management requirements, generally require at least one initial in-person onboarding interview with the legal representative and signatories of the S.A.S., with physical presentation of original corporate documents and identity certificates. Post-COVID remote onboarding exists at several institutions but is discretionary, not a legal right. If a bank permits remote onboarding, it usually requires a notarized apostilled power-of-attorney for a local representative who will sign documentation in Colombia. The presence of the ultimate beneficial owner(s) is not required locally if their identities are disclosed through the corporate KYC dossier and verified by the bank's compliance area.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO structure includes a foreign corporate parent or non-resident shareholder without transparent ownership evidence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the S.A.S. bylaws and shareholders' registry (Cámara de Comercio certificate), UBO diagram, passport copies and foreign tax identification certificates for each ultimate beneficial owner, sworn AML/CFT questionnaire, and a legal opinion confirming no bearer shares exist.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent business profile: registered NACE/ISIC activity (7120 – technical testing and analysis) does not match large or frequent cross-border transactions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed laboratory service agreements, ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation certificate, UN38.3 testing scope statement, commercial invoices for testing projects, Client Know-Your-Customer documentation confirming the non-resident counterparty relationship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection from abroad below the minimum capital threshold or lacking a clear underlying contribution purpose.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sworn capital integration statement signed by each shareholder, board minutes approving the equity contribution, bank wire reference letter with legal purpose field labeled 'share capital contribution to Colombian S.A.S.', and copy of the FDI registration declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk correspondent jurisdiction for the sending bank or financier of the testing laboratory.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank reference from a first-tier bank in the origin country, independent risk assessment report on the corporate group, FATF-consistent source of funds evidence, audited financial statements, and a compliance opinion confirming no sanctions on the beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Physical absence of directors at the time of account opening.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled power-of-attorney granted to a local Colombian legal representative, notarized letter of authorization from the board, passport and citizenship card copies, and a signed corporate acknowledgment of the bank's AML policies.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections for the S.A.S. must come by SWIFT transfer in USD, EUR, or COP to the IMC bank account. The sending reference must contain the purpose 'capital contribution in favor of [SAS company name] – NIT [value]'. The beneficiary bank requires the S.A.S. tax ID (NIT), account number, bank code, and, for USD transfers, the bank's correspondent ABA/IBAN. Within 30 days after receipt (or in the required statutory deadline), the investment must be declared using the Banco de la República's foreign exchange declaration for inward international investment, signed by the legal representative, and submitted through the IMC. The declared value must equal the COP-equivalent of the injected funds and the relevant capital account codes must be used. All supporting documents (bank receipt, capital integration minutes, constitutional document) must be preserved for DIAN and Banco de la República inspections.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for trade settlements shall be executed through (i) SWIFT MT103 for uncomplicated low-value service payments to foreign laboratories, calibration centers, or consultants; (ii) SWIFT MT202/MT210 for interbank nostro cover where applicable; (iii) documentary collection (DP/DA) for medium-value equipment purchases; and (iv) commercial letters of credit (sight or usance) for high-value capital equipment and calibrated laboratory machinery. All outbound trade payments must be supported by the corresponding import declaration / service agreement and submitted to the IMC for the applicable foreign exchange return. Peso-denominated local disbursements can be paid using Colombia's ACH (CUD / CENIT) rails and are outside the FX declaration agenda.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP outright FX forwards (forward de divisas) with authorized Colombian banks or IMCs for locking future repatriation or import costs.
USD/COP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for hedging COP depreciation or appreciation through cash settlement in COP without physical delivery of USD.
USD/COP foreign exchange options (call/put) for protection against adverse COP movements on trade and capital flows.
Cross-currency swaps (currency swaps) for longer-term balance-sheet hedging of USD-denominated debt or lease liabilities.

FX derivatives executable only with local financial institutions licensed in Colombia and only for genuine risk-hedging purposes; speculative transactions by non-bank corporations are strictly scrutinized and require underlying real trade or investment exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By April 9 of the following tax year (exact date depends on NIT last two digits)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine of 5% of the tax assessed (minimum 10 UVT, maximum 1,500 UVT) plus interest; potential criminal liability for willful omission.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registry Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of up to 1% of net worth; if renewal is not completed within 6 months, the commercial registry registration is cancelled (administrative strike-off).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Report (Reporte de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, by June 30 (per DIAN Resolution 164 of 2021)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance fines of up to 400 UVT (approx. USD 19,000 in 2025); repeat violations may trigger enhanced scrutiny.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Financial Statements Filing (Estados Financieros ante Cámara de Comercio)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after approval by shareholders; approval must occur by March 31, so the legal deadline is April 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties are applied; registration may be suspended, and renewal cannot be completed until the statements are accepted.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent audit (Revisor Fiscal) is mandatory if the entity has total assets exceeding 5,000 UVT (approx. COP 235 million / USD 60,000), gross income exceeding 3,000 UVT (approx. COP 141 million / USD 36,000), employs more than 200 workers, or is a public-interest entity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS for large entities; IFRS for SMEs (NIIF PYMES) for Group 2; simplified tax GAAP for micro entities (Group 3) — all under Decreto 2420 of 2015.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The final beneficial owner report must be filed annually with DIAN by June 30. Any transfer of shares must be registered in the internal share register and reported via the UBO platform within the same annual filing; after the filing, direct transfers are not separately confirmed until the next cycle.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Registro de Directivos)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $200 – $800 per year for a virtual office; $500 – $1,500 for a physical legal address in Bogotá or Medellín
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $1,500 – $4,000 for a small SAS audit (Revisor Fiscal) depending on transaction volume and subsidiaries

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday; 25% tax credit (descuento tributario) on qualified Science, Technology and Innovation (ACTI) investments, capped at 20% of the basic income tax; 30% additional deduction for certain environmental investments; Free Trade Zone regime: 20% CIT for authorized ZF users; dividends from certain investments abroad may benefit from the CHC holding regime (not available to a standard SAS lab).
